actual_artifact_probes.expected: The entry assembler accepts the pinned contract-freeze-entry receipt generated by verify_contract_freeze.py.
actual_artifact_probes.actual: Exit 1: ValueError: freeze check phase is required.
actual_artifact_probes.reason: The assembler expects phase, contract_hash, and byte_count instead of the actual phase_id, contract_file_sha256, and contract_byte_count fields. It also compares byte_count to the freeze-output file size rather than the contract size.

actual_artifact_probes.expected: The entry assembler accepts the actual k_guard_qwen_parallel_health.v2 receipt.
actual_artifact_probes.actual: Exit 1: ValueError: health receipt missing required field: model.
actual_artifact_probes.reason: The assembler expects model, token_usage, and workers[].status instead of requested_model_id, positive workers[].usage, healthy, runtime_model_id, exit_code, and the aggregate v2 health fields.

actual_artifact_probes.expected: The product receipt validator and phase decision assembler consume one frozen receipt schema.
actual_artifact_probes.reason: The product validator requires token_usage, provider_envelope_path, and provider_envelope_sha256. The decision assembler requires schema, usage, and a nested provider_envelope object.

actual_artifact_probes.expected: The automatic product gate requires SOL, Opus, and Grok, with GLM advisory-only.
actual_artifact_probes.actual: Exit 1: automatic REQUIRED_MODELS remains Claude, Grok, and GLM.
actual_artifact_probes.reason: The new SOL-Opus-Grok evaluator is not wired into the automatic health or execution path, while the legacy execution path still treats GLM as mandatory.

direct_review_findings.finding: The entry assembler cannot consume the actual pinned freeze receipt and does not validate the contract agreement or pinned checker.
The entry assembler cannot consume the actual Qwen health v2 receipt and does not bind the exact requested model, provider, runtime model, base commit, exit code, or per-worker usage.
The automatic supervisor path still requires GLM and omits SOL.
The separate product evaluator invents a fixed codex-sol model ID, is not wired to execution, and accepts receipts whose attempt values can differ.
Its receipt schema is byte-incompatible with the separate product evaluator, so one real receipt set cannot satisfy both gates.
Repository-local output is not rejected, resolved symlink checks are ineffective for parent symlink components, and the tool emits an unstructured traceback instead of a fail-closed control envelope.
Focused tests fabricate the incorrect freeze and health schemas, explaining the 155-test false pass.

full_regression_skip_reason: The preregistered direct contract review kill condition fired before the full-regression gate. Running later gates cannot cure an actual-artifact incompatibility.
